source: reconstruction of a private repository with every action pinned
note: A private repository's workflows cannot be published in this corpus, so this is a minimal reproduction of the shape: every action pinned by SHA from GitHub's own owners, checkout credentials not persisted, main protected, a tag-triggered release in an environment. The one entry is the pull request title echoed into the step summary of a test job holding a read token: code execution, High on a public repository, and one tier down to Medium here, since visibility is proven private and a contributor entry then needs an account with access. Hand count: one Medium path 6, one other finding (ISSUE-705, High, 10), so 100 - 16 = 84: B.
